name: Escalona (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the crowned arms of Escalona (a castle and a ladder on red above waves).
history: The heraldic arms were officially approved on 23 December 1976 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 25 January 1977. The municipal flag, approved on 24 October 2005 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 10 November 2005, is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, white with a red cross, bearing at the centre the arms of Escalona.
